abilities.name: Innervate
abilities.description: Grant an allied Hero 20% of their maximum Mana over 5 seconds. While affected by Innervate, their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster. yellowtext Cannot be used on Heroes that do not use Mana.; 25; trait

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.description: Heal an allied Hero for 380 Health over 20 seconds.

fields.notes: Casting Regrowth sets Malfurion's Basic Attack's cooldown to 0.5 seconds, potentially causing his next attack to come out faster or slower.

abilities.name: Moonfire
abilities.description: Deal 90 damage to enemies in an area and reveal them for 2 seconds. Allies with an active Regrowth are healed for 130 Health for each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Revealed, Triggered Heal
fields.notes: Healing from Moonfire does not have a range limitation. Healing from each Moonfire hit is dealt in a separate instance.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.description: Root enemy Heroes in an area for 1.25 seconds, and deal 117 damage over the duration. Affected area grows over 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Only deals damage when the Root connects, and therefore cannot damage anything except Heroes who are not currently Unstoppable or in Stasis. 1) The area grows every 0.5 seconds in 0.5 ... 0.75 increments, reaching maximum radius 2.0 seconds after the center appeared. After reaching its maximum radius, the area lingers for 1.25 seconds

abilities.name: Tranquility
abilities.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affect by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.; 80; 80; heroic

fields.notes: Casting Tranquility sets Malfurion's Basic Attack's cooldown to 0.5 seconds, potentially causing his next attack to come out faster or slower. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Twilight Dream
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies, making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.; 90; 100; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Silence
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown.

talents.name: Deep Roots
talents.description: Entangling Roots grows 25% larger and persists on the ground 40% longer. Repeatable Quest Every time an enemy Hero becomes Rooted, gain 14 Mana permanently.

fields.notes: Bonus duration is split between growth to bonus radius and linger duration: time to reach maximum radius (now 3.75) is increased by 0.5 seconds and the linger duration by 0.25 seconds. Quest bonus increases both maximum and current Mana by given amount.

_raw_fields: Entangling Roots grows 25% larger and persists on the ground 40% longer. Repeatable Quest Every time an enemy Hero becomes Rooted, gain 14 Mana permanently.

talents.name: Vengeful Roots
talents.description: Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that does 58 damage per second and lasts 10 seconds. Repeatable Quest Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7. Treant
_raw_fields: Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that does 58 damage per second and lasts 10 seconds. Repeatable Quest Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7. Treant

talents.name: Emerald Dreams
talents.description: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

fields.notes: The Sleep effect is not applied if the Root is cleansed

_raw_fields: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

talents.name: Rejuvenation
talents.description: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

fields.notes: Rejuvenation counts toward the total number of active Regrowths. Rejuvenation benefits from bonus healing from Ysera's Gift, but not from Lifebloom. Rejuvenation benefits from Wild Growth 's duration increase when hitting enemies with Moonfire, but doesn't gain even a partial duration increase from Nature's Balance.

_raw_fields: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

talents.name: Celestial Alignment
talents.description: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 second. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.
_raw_fields: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 second. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.

talents.name: Shan'do's Clarity
talents.description: Gain a second charge of Innervate. Its cooldown recharges 25% faster per ally affected by Regrowth.

fields.notes: Each Regrowth reduces the remaining cooldown of Innervate by 0.25 seconds every time it ticks (1 per second).

_raw_fields: Gain a second charge of Innervate. Its cooldown recharges 25% faster per ally affected by Regrowth.

talents.name: Wild Growth
talents.description: Each enemy hit by Moonfire extends the duration of currently active Regrowths by 1 second.
_raw_fields: Each enemy hit by Moonfire extends the duration of currently active Regrowths by 1 second.

talents.name: Tenacious Roots
talents.description: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.
_raw_fields: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.

talents.name: Nature's Cure
talents.description: cooldown 45 Active Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.
_raw_fields: cooldown 45 Active Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

talents.name: Tranquility
talents.description: cooldown 80 Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affect by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.
_raw_fields: cooldown 80 Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affect by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
talents.description: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

fields.notes: Movement Speed bonus stacks additively with itself, but not with other Movement Speed bonuses.

_raw_fields: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

talents.name: Hindering Moonfire
talents.description: Moonfire Slows Enemy Heroes by 25% for 3 seconds.
_raw_fields: Moonfire Slows Enemy Heroes by 25% for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Revitalize
talents.description: Using Innervate also grants Malfurion 15% of his maximum Mana and causes his Basic Ability cooldowns to refresh 50% faster for 5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Using Innervate also grants Malfurion 15% of his maximum Mana and causes his Basic Ability cooldowns to refresh 50% faster for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Ysera's Gift
talents.description: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Regrowth 's healing.

_raw_fields: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

talents.name: Nature's Balance
talents.description: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Actually increases radius by 25%, so area by 56.25%. Causes Regrowth to tick 5 additional times for an additional 95 healing over time.

_raw_fields: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

talents.name: Moonlit Harmony
talents.description: Increase Moonfire's heal by 20%, and 15% per ally affected by Regrowth.

fields.notes: Healing bonus stacks additively with itself and other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Moonfire 's healing.

_raw_fields: Increase Moonfire's heal by 20%, and 15% per ally affected by Regrowth.

talents.name: Serenity
talents.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 3 seconds. Increase Tranquility's healing by 25% and 10% per ally affected by Regrowth.

fields.notes: Healing bonuses stack additively with themselves and other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Tranquility 's healing.

_raw_fields: Each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 3 seconds. Increase Tranquility's healing by 25% and 10% per ally affected by Regrowth.

talents.name: Astral Communion
talents.description: Activate to channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location. Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream. Passive Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Activate to channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location. Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream. Passive Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.

talents.name: Lifebloom
talents.description: Casting Regrowth instantly heals its target for 10% of their missing Health.
_raw_fields: Casting Regrowth instantly heals its target for 10% of their missing Health.

talents.name: Lunar Shower
talents.description: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Moonfire 's damage.

_raw_fields: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.
